thread:
zara: Quick update for the docs + SDK teams: we've extended the Legacy SDK (2.x/3.x) deprecation runway. New public EOL: 2027-03-31.
zara: Reason: multiple enterprise migrations and extra validation windows requested. Were shipping tooling to make migrations smoother rather than forcing an abrupt cutover.
mike: Docs plan: hold all hard redirects from /sdk/legacy for now. I'll publish a dedicated "migration runbook" and a compact FAQ. ETA draft: 2026-05-12.
ethan: Engineering note: introducing an opt-in `compatFlag` in the 4.x series to bridge parameter name changes and a small mapping layer. This is temporary and opt-in only.
viv: CS: we'll segment outreach—top-tier accounts get white-glove; self-serve customers get the CLI + playbook. Need a one-pager and canned email templates.
migrate-bot: release: redwood-migrate v1.2.0 -> try `redwood-migrate --preview` to see suggested diffs. docs: https://internal.redwood.dev/migrator/1.2.0
mike: Draft snippet for the playbook (python + CLI):
```
# python example
from redwood import Client
client = Client(api_key=os.getenv("REDWOOD_API_KEY"), compat={"enabled": True})
# preview suggested changes
redwood-migrate --preview --target sdk3 > migration-report.md
```
ethan: Perf caveat: compatFlag can add ~4-10% latency on small payloads and disables a couple of speculative optimizations. Will document microbenchmarks.
zara: Telemetry: compatFlag will emit a labelled metric `compat_flag=enabled` for internal usage only. No request payloads captured. Opt-in only.
viv: Support runbook items to include: auth header mismatches, streaming edge cases, timeout semantics, and rollback steps for private deployments. I'll coordinate with Support to publish KB articles.
mike: Playbook outline: 1) pre-checklist (migrator scan) 2) automated patch examples + PR templates 3) manual fixes list 4) rollback guidance 5) public FAQ blurb.
zara: Action items: - Mike: playbook draft + PR templates by 2026-05-12 - Ethan: compatFlag PR for 4.x by 2026-04-18 - Viv: CS templates + outreach plan by 2026-05-01 - Support: KB runbooks by 2026-04-25
announcer-bot: staging updated: https://staging.docs.redwood.dev/migration-runbook-2187654321 (staging token required).
ethan: Note for on-prem customers: compatFlag will be available in the next SDK build but some private installs may require a manual compatibility bundle. Escalate to eng-infra for those.
mike: Draft public page blurb: "Weve extended the sunset for Legacy SDKs to Mar 31, 2027. To help customers migrate were providing an optional compatibility flag and an updated migration CLI. See the migration runbook for guidance or contact support for assistance."
viv: Small edit: call out that the compatFlag is temporary and targeted outreach is planned for high-usage accounts.
zara: Agreed. We'll finalize the public copy after the playbook and CS templates are ready, then announce in #general. If anyone has strong wording suggestions, drop them here. :thumbsup:
